explanation: The value is nonzero only at GO steps, and only late in the episode: 0 everywhere before about trial 75, around 2-4 at GO over trials 75-85, and usually 8-10 at GO from about trial 85 to 95, mostly when the agent keeps choosing a1 and keeps landing in S1. It is always 0 at D1 and D2, and even late in the episode it drops to 0 at the GO right after a trial that ended in a rare S2 (or right after a switch of choice), then climbs back to 9-10 over the next one or two trials.
